_doc: Rule texts parked on 2026-11-26 (user: fights of several fighters postponed; design/world/depth/DECISIONS-2026-11-26.md). Each entry's idea is counting allies or several fighters. The text is kept unchanged and is not exported until such fights return. An entry names the file, the record and the field: an entry under `techniques.arts` parks that one art, not its technique; an item effect or a set bonus parks that line; a whole record is parked when all its rule fields are listed. People are never parked.

records.text: Geese Stance (Nhạn Thế): a stance. While you count three or more allies (you, companions, Pieces), the damage you take is multiplied by 0.9 for each ally beyond yourself; while you fight Alone, 40 % of each hit is held back and lands over the next 4 s, and healing pays it off first. You gain a small ward every 3 s the stance holds. Being Displaced breaks the line.

records.text: The elders' war art, named for the second half of the founder's line: the autumn water is one colour with the long sky. The holder spreads Earth and Wood qi across a field until ground, grass and sky look one colour, so a foe inside cannot judge distance or tell which shapes are men. The holder sees clearly. Inside the field the holder's arts strike every foe in it at reduced weight, and foes lose accuracy and hidden things are revealed. It needs a rank: with fewer than three allies standing in the field it is weak, which is why the sect fights as a line and lost at Thiết Tỏa Quan.
records.note: record needs a rank of allies (fewer than three allies is weak); whole record parked

records.text: A method for a file, not for one person. Each disciple learns to pass qi down the line the way geese trade the lead in a long flight: the one at the point takes the wind, and when the point tires it falls back and the next takes it. The canon cultivates no element. It trains the meridians to give and take a share of a neighbour's strain, so a file of five fights as one body with five pairs of hands. Alone, a disciple of the gate is ordinary. In file they are very hard to break, and they get stronger the longer the line holds.
records.note: a file of five fighting as one body; payoff needs several fighters

records.text: A stance. While you count three or more allies (you, companions, Pieces), the damage you take is multiplied by 0.9 for each ally beyond yourself; while you fight Alone, 40 % of each hit is held back and lands over the next 4 s, and healing pays it off first. You gain a small ward every 3 s the stance holds. Being Displaced breaks the line. This is the stance Cảnh Trường Thiên carried into Lạc Hà's Autumn Water and the Long Sky.
